purpose: Teach: 終る/顧み/ためらい/程遠い/まるっきり/ひとたび/きまり/だいじょうぶ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、宿題が早く終ると、お絵描きできるわね
lines.en: Sho, if you finish your homework early, you can draw, can't you?
lines.style: Warm, gently encouraging. Opens with his name softly. Light, conversational pace. The tone of a mother offering both incentive and permission, unhurried and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんとの思い出を顧みる時があるよ
lines.en: Mom, sometimes I think about the memories I have with Grandpa.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. Speaks slowly, as if the thought is emerging as he says it. Genuine without being self-conscious. The gentle sincerity of a child sharing something that matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい習い事に、ためらいがあるのね
lines.en: Sho, you seem hesitant about starting something new.
lines.style: Observant and tender. Not a question, but a gentle recognition. Pace slows slightly. Reaches toward understanding without pushing. The voice of someone noticing what a child hasn't quite said aloud yet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんみたいに上手な絵には程遠いよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm nowhere near as good at drawing as Dad is.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact with an undertone of worry. Said without complaint, but with the weight of genuine concern. A pause before 'nowhere near'—acknowledging the gap he sees.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはまるっきりお酒を飲まない方ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad doesn't drink at all, you know.
lines.style: Gentle redirect, not corrective. Warm but purposeful. Speaks as if offering him a piece of perspective he might need right now. Calm, steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ひとたび決めたら最後まで頑張るよ
lines.en: Mom, once I decide to do something, I'll see it through to the end.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Sits up slightly in the voice. Not boastful—just stating a truth about himself he's learned. Steady conviction underneath, spoken gently.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、おやつの時間にもきまりがあるのよ
lines.en: Sho, there are rules about snack time too, you know.
lines.style: Light, practical tone. A gentle boundary-setting, the kind a mother delivers while making something. Not stern—just matter-of-fact kindness. Conversational pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに「だいじょうぶ」って言ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I told Grandpa that everything was okay.
lines.style: Soft and earnest. Spoken with a quiet pride in having done something important. Slightly tremulous—the bravery of a small child who said something hard. Warmth underneath.
